status.detail: One combined literal-candidate attempt is now independently qualified as a focused differential: twenty-four baseline controls and four specific expected gaps, followed by twenty-eight candidate passes across three finite suites. All baseline suites ran before any candidate suite. Baseline/candidate native dispatch counts were 624/648, 400/400 and 363/363, each below the unchanged 800-per-worker limit. Retained-data qualification checked fifty-six product array sets, 5,906 uniquely mapped streams, 310 pipelines and 7,768 inventory hashes. Root SHA headers were present in all thirty-two history blocks; eight baseline log.showRoot=false blocks lacked the root patch and patch-ID row, while every candidate block contained them. The original incorrect header-as-patch readback and a separate intermediate expectation failure remain preserved; corrected readback is separately versioned and source-grounded. No product or experiment rerun occurred. All workers drained naturally, the Job closed, and the sole execution lock and ownership were explicitly released. This is not a full-tree, missing-object, literal-suggestion or converged review result. The seventh Lite review and open root thread remain outstanding; exact feature implementation and remaining validation require their next bounded steps.
